03additionalProperties

Type
boolean
Full path
/electron-persisted-atom-state/mcp-extension-sidebar-catalog/catalog/<item>/tools/<item>/outputSchema/$defs/<entry-key>/additionalProperties
Meaning

Within the tool output schema: Controls object members that do not match this schema’s properties or patternProperties.

Behavior

A boolean can permit or reject those members; a schema constrains their values. The keyword applies relative to declarations in the same schema object.
